Inline comments: Review comments at @crates/gmeow-cli/src/passthrough.rs: - Around line 622-625: Update the Project and Lift input-processing paths around read_source_bytes, std::fs::read, and purrdf::parse_dataset to map each error through a Location containing the corresponding input path and add the matching gmeow math context frame. Apply the same diagnostic enrichment used by the existing lift-r, lift-onnx, and lift-proof paths, ensuring source and reference failures identify the correct file. - Around line 615-629: Update the output-path guard in the passthrough command to reject both identical and equivalent absolute paths for out and ledger, including forms such as ./x and x. Then write emission.ledger to ledger before writing emission.bytes to out, preserving the mandatory-ledger contract. Review comments at @crates/math-lift/src/projection.rs: - Around line 550-557: Replace the manual zero check for the matrix rational denominator with expression::canonical_integer(&denominator.lexical_form)? == "0" after integer_literal validation, matching the checks used by expression::number and inbound::rational. Preserve the existing invalid-denominator error. - Around line 487-495: Update method’s closeMatch handling so that when a closeMatch contributes a selected STATO target, the corresponding class IRI and the skos:closeMatch predicate are recorded in input.boundaries, matching the approximate-mapping behavior in symbol_xml. Preserve exact-match collection and only add the boundary entries when closeMatch values are present. Review comments at @crates/math-lift/src/projection/inbound.rs: - Around line 348-367: Trim the content-variable name before validating and using it as the identity: update the name extraction in the variable-handling branch to map the selected value through str::trim, then reject it when the trimmed value is empty. Preserve the existing NCName validation and use the trimmed name for frame.node("free-variable", name). - Around line 528-538: Update resolve_symbol’s native-reference branch to rely only on RDF_TYPE mathematical-symbol classification, removing both SKOS_EXACT and closeMatch checks there. In the unique-alignment branch, accept either SKOS_EXACT or the SKOS closeMatch predicate when matching the external IRI, preserving native-subject closeMatch mappings. Review comments at @crates/pipeline/src/stages/math_producers.rs: - Around line 300-311: Update st_math_producers so its dataflow_entities narrows the stage-mappings dependency to GRAPH_ALIGNMENTS, matching the existing project_graph selection. Add the corresponding gmeow:BuildDataFlow edge in the pipeline module’s TTL configuration, following the pattern used by st_goal_directed. Review comments at @slices/core/pipeline/module.ttl: - Line 3083: Replace the self-referential loss-ledger SKOS example with wording that refers to the target artifacts whose loss records it carries, and apply the same corrected msgid/msgstr text in the matching French and Chinese translations. Update only the corresponding loss-ledger entries. Review comments at @slices/grounding/math/module.ttl: - Line 16537: Update the math:ProjectionRequest class declaration to add logic cardinality-1 restrictions for math:projectionSource and math:projectionTargetName, preserving its existing math:MathematicalObject superclass and execution behavior.
